description: Returns a paged, filterable, date-sorted list of change records across every project in the company.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free text, split on whitespace. Matches rows whose project name, item name, or "Changed" label contains any of the terms.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Applies on its own.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Applies on its own; pass the same date as date_to for a single day.

parameters.name: actor_id[]
parameters.description: Filter by the acting user’s Procore id

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by date: "asc" or "desc" (default desc, newest first)

old_value_column_name.description: The company's column name for a synced budget type in `old_value`, as when the change was recorded; null when unmapped or not a synced value.

new_value_column_name.description: The company's column name for a synced budget type in `new_value`, as when the change was recorded; null when unmapped or not a synced value.

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry
